name: Capital Investment Subsidy For Creation of Infrastructure Along With Installation of Equipment To Establish Film Studio, Film Making, Museum, Aquarium, Theme Park
benefit:
- The beneficiary will receive a subsidy of 15% against the Fixed Capital Investment approved by the department.
- The maximum ceiling of the subsidy is ₹5,00,00,000/-.

##### ***Conditions***

- _It is mandatory for the unit to operate for at least three years from the date of availing the subsidy._
- _The beneficiary must submit a self-declaration regarding the continuous operation of the unit o
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must establish a new project in one of the following categories: Film Studio, Film Making, Museum, Aquarium, or Theme Park. - The applicant must incur a minimum capital expenditure of ₹1,00,00,000/- as approved by the department. - The applicant must ensure the project falls within the definition of "Tourism Projects" as determined by the Tourism Department. - The applicant must be a legal entity such as a Public/Private Limited Company, Partnership Firm, Proprietary Concern, or other registered legal entity. - The applicant must submit the application for the capital subsidy within one year from the date of commencement of operation. - The applicant must maintain the investment made prior to 3 years from the date of commencement of operation for calculating the capital subsidy. - The applicant must not have claimed capital subsidy/investment promotion assistance for the same project from any other category under the policy.
